bullets.text: 荷姆茲：AIS 統計 7 日平均 4.1 艘/日，較戰前 81 艘 -95%（資料至 10/11），通行嚴重受阻；油輪與 LNG/LPG 運價的地緣溢價須持續觀察。
bullets.text_en: Hormuz: AIS 7-day average of 4.1 transits/day, -95% vs the pre-war 81 (data to 10/11); traffic is severely disrupted. Keep watching the geopolitical premium in tanker and LNG/LPG rates.

bullets.text: 貨櫃：SCFI 3,664 點（10/9），上漲 1.8 點；Drewry WCI US$4,485/FEU（10/15）。
bullets.text_en: Containers: SCFI at 3,664 (10/9), up 1.8; Drewry WCI US$4,485/FEU (10/15).
Dry bulk: BDI at 2,667 (10/14), daily change -134, -16% over the past month; Capesize 5TC US$32,920/day.

bullets.text: 能源：Brent US$105.40/桶（10/16），年增 +72%；歐洲 TTF 天然氣 €85.54/MWh；油價與氣價水準影響油輪、LNG 船需求與船東燃油成本。
bullets.text_en: Energy: Brent at US$105.40/bbl (10/16), +72% y/y; European TTF gas at €85.54/MWh; oil and gas prices drive tanker and LNG carrier demand and owners' fuel costs.

bullets.text: 成本：新加坡 VLSFO US$912/公噸（10/15），較前日 -5.5；燃油約占航次成本四到六成，留意航商轉嫁（BAF）能力。
bullets.text_en: Costs: Singapore VLSFO at US$912/t (10/15), -5.5 d/d; bunkers are roughly 40-60% of voyage costs, so watch carriers' ability to pass them on via BAF.
